messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need final metric names/definitions for GPU pools so Dashboards + Billing can onboard. Focus: SM occupancy, memory headroom, queue depth. Hosted + Dedicated differences.
ryan: I can take ownership of the PromQL snippets for SM occupancy. proposal: sm_occupancy_ratio{pool,model_variant,deployment_tier} = sum(sm_active_warps)/sum(sm_capacity_warps) per pool.
devon: +1 on sm_occupancy_ratio. please include a short-window (1m) and 5m agg for dashboards. avoid high-card labels like model_hash.
tara: For memory can we standardize to bytes? gpu_memory_used_bytes and gpu_memory_total_bytes with labels {gpu_id,pool,dedicated=true|false}. then a derived gauge gpu_memory_util_pct = used/total * 100 for UI.
jules: queue depth: we have two concepts — request queue length (waiting to schedule) and inflight per-GPU backlog. suggest names request_queue_depth{pool,route} and gpu_inflight_ops{gpu_id,pool}. dashboards should show both.
kiran: important: Dedicated pools will expose instance_owner label and tenant_id (redacted for public dashboards). Hosted pools expose customer_tier only. need schema in contract.
maya: Agree. Also add cardinality limits: no more than 5k distinct label combos per metric via scraping/exporter. Devex will enforce.
ryan: Draft PromQL for sm_occupancy_ratio (1m):
```
(sum by (pool) (increase(sm_active_warp_cycles_total[1m]))
/ (sum by (pool) (increase(sm_capacity_warp_cycles_total[1m]))) ) * 100
```
Use cycles as proxy because warp count sampling is noisy.
devon: If we're using counters, make sure to document counter resets and use increase(). Also add sm_active_warp_cycles_total to runtime exporters.
tara: Memory headroom idea — headroom_bytes = gpu_memory_total_bytes - gpu_memory_used_bytes - reserved_bytes. reserved_bytes comes from runtime config (batch cache / kv cache). We'll need a telemetry endpoint for reserved_bytes per pool.
jules: queue depth query (5m rollup):
```
max_over_time(request_queue_length{pool=~".*"}[5m])
```
But for per-route alerting use sum(request_queue_length) by (route) and increase for trends.
kiran: Ownership: eng-runtime owns sm_* and reserved_bytes instrumentation. eng-platform owns the telemetry consumer and dashboard wiring. observability team (ops-bot) will validate cardinality and retention.
ops-bot: reminder: new metrics must include a metric_owner label in their docs and go through telemetry-catalog PR. See https://internal.redwood/telemetry/standards
maya: UX for rollouts: console wants both raw metric and a sm_occupancy_percent_agg for UI (1m spike-protected) — maybe a 95th percentile over 1m. name: sm_occupancy_p95_1m.
ryan: We can provide histograms for per-request scheduling latency too, but that's separate. For SM occupancy p95, compute: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(sm_occupancy_bucket[1m])) — but we don't currently have bucketed occupancy. maybe compute p95 across samples at ingestion.
devon: Simpler: provide sm_occupancy_percent_samples and let the dashboard compute p95. runtime will emit sm_occupancy_percent gauge every 10s.
tara: Retention: dashboards will query 90d for trend lines, but raw 10s samples only retained for 7d at full resolution. aggregated rollups at 1m retained for 90d. ops-bot can confirm.
ops-bot: confirmed: high-res (10s) retained 7d, 1m rollups 90d, 1h rollups 13 months. Cardinality checks will run on the telemetry PR.
jules: Alerts: alert if sm_occupancy_ratio > 95% sustained for 5m in Hosted pools, and > 90% for Dedicated (since dedicated should be provisioned). Also alert on gpu_memory_used_bytes / total > 92% and queue depth spike > baseline * 3.
kiran: For billing inputs, we need per-customer GPU_time_consumed_seconds{tenant_id,model_family,pool}. hosted tenant_id may be hashed. add privacy note.
maya: Action items: 1) eng-runtime opens telemetry PR for sm_occupancy_percent gauge, sm_active_warp_cycles_total, sm_capacity_warp_cycles_total, reserved_bytes; include example labels and cardinality. 2) eng-platform drafts dashboard panels with queries/examples and sends to ops for review. 3) billing to request hashed tenant_id schema. 4) devex to cap labels in exporter.
ryan: I'll open the PR today and attach PromQL examples + unit tests for resets.
devon: ping me on the PR for naming consistency.
jules: I'll prototype the dashboard panels in staging once PR merges.
kiran: I'll prepare the privacy note for hosted tenants.
maya: thanks everyone — we'll regroup after PR review. :thumbsup:
